notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v1.0.3
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES - v1.0.3

With this update, I've updated the version of the game engine for the first time in a while. This ended up causing some bugs, which I was able to fix relatively easily. However, there could be more bugs that I haven't encountered - As such, I'll be leaving this version of the game on the 'experimental' branch for a while to make sure there are no game breaking issues.

To access the experimental branch:
	-Right click on Trash Bandits in your library
	-Go to 'properties'
	-Go to 'betas'
	-In the 'Private betas' field, enter the code "experimental" (don't include quotes)
	-Press "opt into experimental branch"
	-Make sure "experimental - testing branch" is selected in the dropdown menu to the right of "Beta Participation"

CHANGELOG
	-Cardboard box prop is now available in the hotel by default
	-Salami has been moved to level 3-2

1.0 CHALLENGE WINNER EASTER EGGS
	-[spoiler]Added new billboard variation that says "Woof Stays Winning"[/spoiler]
	-[spoiler]New billboard variation has been added to various levels[/spoiler]
	
	-[spoiler]Added a secret area accessible by crawling under the truck in the hotel[/spoiler]
	-[spoiler]Added a new fish that can only be acquired at the end of this secret area[/spoiler]
	
	-[spoiler]Added a new hotel item, "IBS Crunchies"[/spoiler]
	-[spoiler]Added a new hotel guest, Fifi[/spoiler]

	-[spoiler]Added Le Chonk[/spoiler]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v2023.11.3.0
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES - v2023.11.3.0

BONUS MISSIONS
	-Added the first bonus mission! To unlock it, get an A or higher on every level in World 2

BIRDS
	-Added birds
	-Will lift the player until the bird runs out of stamina or the player jumps/disconnects

PERFORMANCE
	-Replaced primitive drawing functions with custom functions that use sprites to reduce vertex batches
	-Implemented vertex buffers for drawing parallelograms from rain blocking objects
	-Number of texture swaps per frame reduced in test case from 198 to 45
	-Number of vertex batches per frame reduced in test case from 299 to 60

SHOPPING CART
	-Will now launch when going off of a ramp
	-Added a new "Turn" track, which will reverse the player's direction when passed

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v2023.10.28.0
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES - v2023.10.28.0

PHYSICS
	-Updated moving platforms to behave more consistently when the player is standing on or clinging to them
	         -Players should no longer get stuck in a platform moving up or down
	-Added sliders for running, airborne, and grapple acceleration for testing

CAMERA
	-Camera now rounds its position to the nearest integer to prevent some objects from "jittering"
	-Camera now centers itself on the grapple point when player is grappling

PERFORMANCE
	-Fixed a bug causing large numbers of surfaces to be created when transitioning between different sized rooms
	-Ropes are now updated in a staggered manner, rather than all simultaneously
	-Ropes are no longer drawn when outside of the camera view
	-Minimum stable FPS changed to 120fps: if FPS dips below this, the game's speed will slow down to help prevent physics bugs
		-Added a "Time Dilation" toggle to disable this

GRAPPLE
	-Fixed a bug where player would sometimes instantly disconnect when grappling from the ground

CLING
	-If player is clinging a wall and slipping downwards from momentum, they will no longer let go of the wall if they reach the bottom

EDITOR
	-Can now use CTRL + X to cut selected assets

SHOPPING CART
	-Added shopping cart
	-Added shopping cart spawner
	-Added shopping cart track

EGG
	-Egg

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v2023.10.17.0
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES - v2023.10.17.0

ZIPLINE
	-Added ziplines!
	-Attach by falling onto them
	-Press JUMP to jump, or DOWN to detach
	-Added zipline nodes to the level editor

GLIDING
	-Glide timer has been removed
	-Picking up a plastic bag gives you 1 charge
	-Gliding uses up the charge
	-Can only have 1 charge by default
	-Golden bags give you infinite charges

EDITOR
	-Can now copy and paste selected assets using CTRL + C and CTRL + V
	-Can be pasted between layers, rooms, levels, etc.

LEVEL SELECT
	-Added an "unlock all levels" button for testing purposes

ANIMATIONS
	-Added teeter animations for when the player is standing on a ledge

OTHER
	-Updated spring sprite
	-Added new semisolid platform
	-Fixed a bug with rain block generation

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v2023.10.09.0
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES - v2023.10.09.0

GRAPPLE
	-Player no longer exits grapple if they touch the ground - instead, they will "scoot" towards the grapple point, shortening the grapple length until they are no longer touching the ground. Max "scoot" distance of 0.5 meters. If player is still touching ground after being moved 0.5 meters, they will exit grapple.

EDITOR
	-Levels now support having multiple catalytic converters, all of which must be collected to complete the level
	-Added levers, which act as buttons, but don't activate on "pop" like buttons do

OPTIONS
	-Added a "game speed" option under accessibility, to reduce the game's speed down to a minimum of 50%
	-Option sliders now show their numerical value

SAVE FILES
	-Fixed a bug where starting a new game would not work after loading a file and returning to main menu

TEXT
	-Started moving hard-coded text values (i.e., for UI elements) to the translation file for future localization

REMOTE DOOR
	-Updated remote door sprite

AUDIO
	-Added a new song for the HQ and hotel
	-Updated sounds for lootbox opening and robot alerts

LEVEL SELECT
	-Level select automatically goes to first unfinished level after selecting a world

FISHING
	-Fixed a bug where the "reel" animation would sometimes continuously loop

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v2023.10.02.0

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v2023.09.29.0
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES - v2023.09.29.0
Most of this week was spent working on promotional material as we get closer to early access, but there are some changes nonetheless!

ACHIEVEMENTs
	-Added Steam Achievements
	-Added 19 achievements, more to come

EDITOR
	-Created a text tutorial for the Level Editor
	-Added a link to the Wiki/Tutorial on the main menu
	-Added a "bg x" variable to settings to set the initial offset of background cranes/towers/etc.

LEVELS
	-Added a new room to 2-1 to introduce players to swinging through crates
	-Fixed medal times on 2-3

HOTEL
	-Set a limit of 12 on accumulated hotel logs

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v2023.09.22.0
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES - v2023.09.22.0

BACKGROUNDS
	-Added a new grassy/wooded background for World 3
	-Cranes and other background objects now have their start position randomized

STEAM WORKSHOP
	-When browsing Workshop levels, the creator's display name now appears
	-Added a new default thumbnail for uploaded workshop levels

LOOT ROBOTS
	-Loot robots now have an alertness meter, which increases while it sees the player and decreases while it doesn't
	-Loot robots now need to have line of sight to the player to spot them

DIALOGUE
	-Added lots of dialogue!

HOTEL
	-Added a truck to the hotel to return to HQ without using the pause menu
	-Fixed a bug caused by interacting with a guest and a prop slot simultaneously

RESULTS SCREEN
	-"Continue" and "Restart" buttons now no longer appear until results screen is finished
	-Pressing the A or SPACE while on the results screen now fast-forwards it

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v2023.08.04.0
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES - v2023.08.04.0

LEVELS
-Added new rooms to levels 1-1 through 1-8 containing catalytic converters

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo v2023.06.23.0
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES - Demo v2023.06.23.0

-Performance Mode
	-Now removes shockwave effects
	-Now simplifies physics for debris

-Orange
	-Acceleration changed from 20 - > 30 m/s^2
	-Max speed changed from 15 -> 25 m/s
	
-Level Editor

-Fixed an issue where the level end menu would persist after a manual level reset
-Fixed an issue with textboxes not appearing
-Added TV to level editor

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo v2023.06.21.0
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES - Demo v2023.06.21.0

-Added breakable blocks to the level editor! Can be broken by a ground pound, or when the player has sufficient speed from a grapple, pull, etc.
-Added remote doors to the level editor! Will toggle to be open or closed when activated by a trigger.
-Added dumpsters to the level editor! Act as teleporters which can be linked to a new "teleporter" object.
-Added a "seamless" camera option for level settings. Removes camera restrictions and transitions when going from room to room.

-Added a toggleable "run timer" that persists between levels. Can be reset to 0 in options.

-Can now hold "SPACE" during a cutscene to skip - prompt will appear when in a cutscene the player has seen before.

-Crumbling platforms sprite has been updated to have moss on it, to help make it more distinguishable from the background.
-Time from releasing wall cling to falling reduced from 0.225s to 0.1s.
-All surfaces are now tracked and deleted at the beginning of a new level.
-Level editor now automatically opens the last autosave on launch
